ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Potential Corruption in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial dealings of the Minnesota governor and Minneapolis mayor, looking for potential corruption and abuse of power.
questions: What financial dealings have the governor and mayor been involved in?
Are there any potential conflicts of interest?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that following the money is key to uncovering potential corruption. By analyzing the financial dealings of the governor and mayor, we may be able to uncover evidence of wrongdoing.
